title: A list to act on from the chat
summary: A tool: type its word and see the rows of your table that are still open, each with a button that marks it done.
description: A tool for your team, used from the chat on the web, the phone app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack. Type its word ("/open-tickets") and it lists the rows of your table whose state is open, ten in the chat and every one on the web and in the app. Each row has a button that changes its state to done, marks that row, and shows the list again. Since its button changes a row, it asks yes before it runs. Choose the word it is called by, the table, the state column and its two values when you install it; if the word is taken, it gets the next free one (open-tickets-2) and says so.

params.name: command
params.title: Its word
params.description: What people type to use it, after /. Letters, numbers and dashes.

params.name: title_column
params.title: Each row shows
params.description: The column each row is named by, such as title.

params.name: state_column
params.title: State column
params.description: The column that says where a row is, such as status.

params.name: open_state
params.title: Listed when
params.description: The state of the rows it lists.

params.name: done_state
params.title: The button makes it
params.description: The state a row's button sets.

definition.name: List and act
definition.description: Lists the open rows of a table, each with a button that marks it done.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.title: Rows
outputs.description: The open rows, each with its id and title
outputs.value: =steps.find.output.rows.map(r, {'id': 'id' in r ? int(r['id']) : 0, 'title': {{title_column}} in r ? string(r[{{title_column}}]) : ''})

tool.name: List and act
tool.about: The open rows of your table, each with a button
